    <dc:description><P>The world's best-selling mystery with over 100 million copies sold!<p>Ten people, each with something to hide and something to fear, are invited to a lonely mansion on Indian Island by a host who, surprisingly, fails to appear. On the island they are cut off from everything but each other and the inescapable shadows of their own past lives. One by one, the guests share the darkest secrets of their wicked pasts. And one by one, they die…<p>The Spectator (London): ‘Agatha Christie's masterpiece.’<p>The New York Times: ‘The whole thing is utterly impossible and utterly fascinating. It is the most baffling mystery Agatha Christie has ever written.’</dc:description>
